title: 2-Week Exam Countdown
subtitle: block exam plan
note: Days 14-8: finish new material, start question blocks. Days 7-3: questions first, then review every miss. Days 2-1: light review, your weak-topic list, early night.

after.title: Miss log + exam eve
after.note: Write down why you missed it, not just what the answer was. That's the part that sticks!

items: Light review only, no new material

Set a stop time and keep it
Catch up on reviews the next day
Write 2 things to change for next block
